name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: A stack of disclosures on black: neutral hairlines between the rows, an ABC Diatype question, a muted answer that opens in place and a chevron that turns. One open at a time, or several.
use_for: Questions on a contact or help page, filters a person opens one by one, settings that would crowd a view.
never: Hiding the one thing a person came for: put it on the page
A #141414 card per row: rows are hairlines on black
A chevron that moves on hover
source: shadcn's accordion, drawn in the Agencidev tokens (brand/tokens.css, from the site's app/globals.css and components/page-tokens.ts): the near-black canvas and white ink, the greys, square corners with the 4px plate, ABC Diatype and Agencidev Sans, color changes on hover and press only.

examples.name: Faq
examples.label: Questions
examples.content:
<!-- Questions on the contact page, one open at a time; the first opens with the page. -->
<agd-accordion value="what" class="w-160 max-w-full">
  <agd-accordion-item value="what" heading="What is Agencidev?">A distributed product design and development studio: product design, branding, strategy and full-stack development, as ongoing monthly partnerships.</agd-accordion-item>
  <agd-accordion-item value="price" heading="How does a partnership work?">A monthly partnership with one team, cancellable at any time.</agd-accordion-item>
  <agd-accordion-item value="team" heading="Who will I work with?">The designers and engineers who do the work, on a shared channel with your team.</agd-accordion-item>
</agd-accordion>

examples.name: Multiple
examples.label: Several open
examples.content:
<!-- Several rows open at once, for services a person compares side by side; the last is not available yet. -->
<agd-accordion multiple value='["design","engineering"]' class="w-120 max-w-full">
  <agd-accordion-item value="design" heading="Design">Product design, branding, design systems.</agd-accordion-item>
  <agd-accordion-item value="engineering" heading="Engineering">Web, iOS, Android.</agd-accordion-item>
  <agd-accordion-item value="hardware" heading="Hardware" disabled>Coming soon.</agd-accordion-item>
</agd-accordion>
